translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Wach mokor nibiro timore ne Damaski
Ma e wach mane okor kuom Damaski:

content.text: “Neuru, Damaski ok nochak obed dala maduongʼ,
to obiro bedo pidhe mag gik mokethi.
Mier madongo mag Aroer nodongʼ gunda
nodongʼ kar nindo jamni kendo onge ngʼama nobwog-gi.
Dala maduongʼ mochiel nolal nono koa Efraim
nyaka kom loch man Damaski;
jo-Aram manok modongʼ tekogi norum
mana kaka mar jo-Israel norumo,”
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema owacho.
“E kindeno duongʼ mar Jakobo nolal;
kendo nodok manok.
Nochal mana ka jakeyo mabeto cham
choko kamoro achiel bangʼe okayogi gi lwete mana kaka jahulo,
hulo cham e Holo mar Refaim.
Kaka cham dongʼ e puodho bangʼ hulo,
e kaka olembe mag zeituni nodongʼ e yath kosepon,
olembe ariyo kata adek nyalo dongʼ ewi bede yath mamalo
kendo olembe angʼwen kata abich nyalo dongʼ e bedene monyaa,”
Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel ema owacho.
E kindeno ji nongʼi Jachwechgi
kendo gichom wengegi kuom Jal Maler mar Israel.
Ok gini ngʼi kende mag misango,
kata kuom tije mag lwetgi,
kendo ok ginibed gi luor ne sirni mag Ashera
kata ne kende miwangʼoe ubani ma lwetgi oloso.

content: E kindeno miechgi madongo mochiel motegno, mane giweyo nikech jo-Israel, biro chalo gi kuonde mojwangʼ motimo bunge kod buya kendo giduto ginidongʼ gunda.

content.text: Wiyi osewil gi Nyasachi ma jaresni;
adier ok iseparo Lwanda ma en ohingani.
Kuom mano kata ka ipidho cham mabeyo
kendo ipidho mzabibu migolo e pinje ma oko,
kata obedo ni chiengʼ mipidhogieno ema gidongoe
kendo okinyi ma ipidhogieno ema gichiewoe,
onge gima niyudi to makmana chandruok kod rem ma ok rum.
Yaye, winjuru mahu mar ogendini mangʼeny,
giwuo mana ka apaka mar nam!
Yaye, winjuru koko mar ji, ka gimor mana ka apaka mar nam!
Kata obedo ni gimor mana ka pi mogingore,
to ka akwerogi to giniring ma gidhi mabor,
mana machal gi mihudhwe mipiedho e gode ma yamo tero,
kata ka yamo mar kalausi.
Kochopo odhiambo, kibaji nogogi apoya nono!
To kapok piny oru, to ginilal nono!
Ma e pok mar joma mayowa,
kendo en e pok mar joma yakowa.
